response.rationale: These are different concepts. RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1) handles its own Booking records through BookingRepository (create, get, list, listBySession, update). It reads ClubBooking records through a separate ClubBookingRepository (node 440da90bcde7901a), only via listByDate in RinkService.effectiveCapacity. That suggests club bookings reserve ice time and lower the capacity left for individual session bookings. ClubService manages ClubBooking along with rates and invoicing. Two repositories, two owning services and one feeding the other's capacity all point to two related but distinct reservation concepts that only share the word "booking". This is based mostly on graph calls; only one line of code from each file is visible, so the capacity point is an inference.
